question: List all products along with their BOM version details, including only those products which have at least one BOM version associated, sorted by product name and version number.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:HasBomVersion]->(bv:BomVersion) RETURN p.name AS ProductName, bv.version_number AS VersionNumber ORDER BY p.name, bv.version_number

question: Find the total quantity required for all materials used in assemblies that are part of product 'P000001'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`{Product_id:'P000001'})-[:ConsistsOf]->(a:Assembly)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN SUM(m.quantity_required) AS total_quantity

question: List all products along with their associated manufacturing orders and the total quantity ordered for each product, sorted by the total quantity in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)<-[r:OrderedFor]-(mo:ManufacturingOrder) RETURN p.name AS ProductName, SUM(r.required_quantity) AS TotalQuantityOrdered ORDER BY TotalQuantityOrdered DESC

question: Display the average lead time of materials grouped by supplier name, including suppliers who haven't supplied any materials yet.
gql: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material) RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, AVG(m.lead_time) AS AverageLeadTime ORDER BY AverageLeadTime

question: Determine the average lead time of materials grouped by their categories, considering only those materials that are directly used in products.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN m.category, AVG(m.lead_time) AS average_lead_time

question: Find suppliers who provide materials used in products with a revision level of 'A', returning supplier names and the count of distinct materials supplied.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.revision_level = 'A' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, COUNT(m) AS MaterialsSuppliedCount

question: List all products along with their total required quantities of materials, grouped by product name and ordered by the total quantity in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN p.name AS ProductName, SUM(c.quantity_required) AS TotalQuantityRequired ORDER BY TotalQuantityRequired DESC

question: Identify all work centers that are involved in manufacturing products which have undergone engineering changes, showing distinct work center names.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`)-[:ModifiedBy]->(:EngineeringChange) RETURN DISTINCT wc.name AS WorkCenterName

question: Determine the count of manufacturing orders per status, including statuses with zero orders, and order the results by the count in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder) RETURN mo.status AS OrderStatus, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount ORDER BY OrderCount ASC

question: Determine the average lead time of materials used in assemblies which are part of products having a revision level of 'Rev2'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`{revision_level:'Rev2'})-[:ConsistsOf]->(a:Assembly)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN AVG(m.lead_time) AS AverageLeadTime

question: Retrieve all engineering changes that affect products currently in 'Active' status, and include details about the change reason and approval status.
gql: MATCH (ec:EngineeringChange)<-[:ModifiedBy]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN ec.reason_code, ec.approval_status, ec.description

question: List all products that have at least one material with a lead time greater than 20 days, along with the total number of such materials per product.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE m.lead_time > 20 RETURN p.Product_id, COUNT(m) AS material_count

question: Retrieve the names of suppliers who supply materials used in products that are currently in 'Active' status, ensuring no duplicate supplier names in the result.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN DISTINCT s.name

question: Identify work centers that are capable of manufacturing products with a cycle time less than 30 minutes, and return the product names and work center names.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[m:ManufacturedAt]->(w:WorkCenter) WHERE m.cycle_time < 30 RETURN p.name AS ProductName, w.name AS WorkCenterName

question: Find materials that can substitute for other materials, showing the original material name, substitute material name, and the priority ranking of the substitution.
gql: MATCH (m1:Material)-[s:SubstitutesFor]->(m2:Material) RETURN m1.name AS OriginalMaterial, m2.name AS SubstituteMaterial, s.priority_ranking AS PriorityRanking

question: Count the number of alternative components (materials/assemblies) used in each product, considering only those with an alternative flag set to true.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[co:ConsistsOf]->(comp) WHERE co.alternative_flag = true RETURN p.Product_id, COUNT(comp) AS alternative_component_count LIMIT 10

question: Identify all products that have at least one material substitute and return the product name along with the count of substitutes.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material)-[s:SubstitutesFor]->(:Material) RETURN p.name, COUNT(s) AS substitute_count

question: Find the average cycle time for all manufacturing processes at work centers that have manufactured at least one assembly with a weight greater than 50 units.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(a:Assembly) WHERE a.weight > 50 RETURN AVG(ma.cycle_time) AS AverageCycleTime

question: Identify all manufacturing orders that involve products requiring materials with a unit cost higher than 50, including the order ID, product name, and total quantity of such expensive materials per order.
gql: MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[o:OrderedFor]->(p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE m.unit_cost > 50 RETURN mo.ManufacturingOrder_id AS OrderID, p.name AS ProductName, SUM(c.quantity_required) AS TotalExpensiveMaterialsQuantity

question: Show all manufacturing orders with their due dates and the corresponding product names, including those orders where the product has been discontinued (status is 'Discontinued'), and sort the results by due date in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[r:OrderedFor]->(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Discontinued' RETURN mo.ManufacturingOrder_id, mo.due_date, p.name ORDER BY mo.due_date ASC

question: List all work centers along with the count of distinct products they are involved in manufacturing, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`) RETURN wc.name AS WorkCenterName, COUNT(p) AS ProductCount ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

question: Count the number of distinct materials used in each product, considering only those materials that have a lead time greater than 10 days, and order the results by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[co:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE m.lead_time > 10 RETURN p.name AS ProductName, COUNT(m) AS DistinctMaterialCount ORDER BY DistinctMaterialCount DESC

question: Identify the top 5 work centers with the highest total setup time required for manufacturing products, including the work center name and the total setup time.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`) RETURN wc.name AS WorkCenterName, SUM(ma.setup_time) AS TotalSetupTime ORDER BY TotalSetupTime DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names of products along with the latest effective date of their bill of material versions, including only those products where the latest version status is 'Active'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:HasBomVersion]->(bv:BomVersion) RETURN p, MAX(bv.effective_date) AS LatestEffectiveDate NEXT MATCH (p)-[:HasBomVersion]->(bv:BomVersion{effective_date:LatestEffectiveDate}) WHERE bv.status = 'Active' RETURN p.name AS ProductName, bv.effective_date AS LatestEffectiveDate

question: List suppliers who supply materials used in products with a status of 'Discontinued', showing the supplier name and the total number of such materials.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[co:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Discontinued' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, COUNT(m.Material_id) AS DiscontinuedMaterialsCount

question: Show suppliers who have provided materials for products with at least two different revision levels, listing supplier name and the count of distinct revision levels involved.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, COUNT(p.revision_level) AS RevisionLevelsCount ORDER BY RevisionLevelsCount DESC

question: List all manufacturing orders with their corresponding product names and the total quantity of materials required for each product in those orders, sorted by the order due date.
gql: MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[o:OrderedFor]->(p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN mo.ManufacturingOrder_id AS OrderID, p.name AS ProductName, SUM(c.quantity_required) AS TotalMaterialQuantity ORDER BY mo.due_date

question: Identify all products that have at least one alternative material in their bill of materials, and return the product name along with the count of such alternative materials.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE c.alternative_flag = true RETURN p.name AS ProductName, COUNT(m) AS AlternativeMaterialCount

question: Determine the top 5 work centers by the number of distinct products they manufacture, including the work center name and the count of distinct products.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`) RETURN wc.name AS WorkCenterName, COUNT(p) AS DistinctProductCount ORDER BY DistinctProductCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find suppliers who supply materials that are substitutes for other materials, and return the supplier names along with the count of such substitute relationships.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m1:Material)-[:SubstitutesFor]->(m2:Material) RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, COUNT(*) AS SubstituteRelationships

question: List all materials that have at least one substitute material, showing the original material name, substitute material name, and the substitution reason.
gql: MATCH (m1:Material)-[sf:SubstitutesFor]->(m2:Material) RETURN m1.name AS OriginalMaterial, m2.name AS SubstituteMaterial, sf.substitution_reason AS Reason

question: Retrieve all engineering changes that were implemented after their deadline, including the change ID, description, effective date, and implementation deadline.
gql: MATCH (ec:EngineeringChange) WHERE ec.implementation_deadline < ec.effective_date RETURN ec.EngineeringChange_id AS ChangeID, ec.description AS Description, ec.effective_date AS EffectiveDate, ec.implementation_deadline AS Deadline

question: Find all engineering changes that have been implemented (implementation status 'Completed') and affected products or assemblies manufactured at work centers located in 'Factory A'. Return the engineering change ID, description, and the name of the work center.
gql: MATCH (ec:EngineeringChange)<-[mb:ModifiedBy]-(n)-[ma:ManufacturedAt]->(wc:WorkCenter) WHERE mb.implementation_status = 'Completed' AND wc.location = 'Factory A' RETURN ec.EngineeringChange_id AS ChangeID, ec.description AS Description, wc.name AS WorkCenterName

question: Identify the top 3 suppliers by the total quantity of materials they supply, considering only materials used in active products (status = 'Active'), and return the supplier name along with the total quantity supplied.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[co:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, SUM(co.quantity_required) AS TotalQuantitySupplied ORDER BY TotalQuantitySupplied DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all materials that can substitute for other materials, including the original material name, substitute material name, and the substitution reason, ordered by the priority ranking of the substitution.
gql: MATCH (m1:Material)-[sf:SubstitutesFor]->(m2:Material) RETURN m1.name AS OriginalMaterial, m2.name AS SubstituteMaterial, sf.substitution_reason AS Reason ORDER BY sf.priority_ranking ASC

question: Determine the average cycle time for manufacturing products at each work center, considering only those work centers which have manufactured more than 5 distinct products, and display the results sorted by average cycle time in descending order.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`) RETURN wc, COUNT(p) AS ProductCount, AVG(ma.cycle_time) AS AvgCycleTime NEXT RETURN wc.name AS WorkCenterName, AvgCycleTime ORDER BY AvgCycleTime DESC

question: Identify suppliers who supply materials used in products that are part of manufacturing orders with a status of 'Completed', returning the supplier name and the count of distinct materials supplied.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`)<-[:OrderedFor]-(mo:ManufacturingOrder) WHERE mo.status = 'Completed' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, COUNT(m.Material_id) AS MaterialsSuppliedCount

question: Find all products that have undergone at least two engineering changes and are currently in 'Active' status. Display the product name, number of changes, and current status.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ModifiedBy]->(ec:EngineeringChange) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN p, COUNT(ec) AS ChangeCount NEXT RETURN p.name AS ProductName, ChangeCount, p.status AS CurrentStatus

question: Retrieve all products that have at least one substitute material with a higher unit cost, displaying the product name and the count of such substitute materials.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material)<-[:SubstitutesFor]-(sm:Material) WHERE sm.unit_cost > m RETURN p.name AS ProductName, COUNT(sm) AS SubstituteMaterialsWithHigherCost

question: List all suppliers who provide materials used in products with a status of 'Active', including the total minimum order quantity per supplier, sorted by this quantity in descending order.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, SUM(sf.minimum_order_quantity) AS TotalMinimumOrderQuantity ORDER BY TotalMinimumOrderQuantity DESC

question: Retrieve the top 10 most substituted materials, showing the original material name, substitute material name, substitution reason, and the count of substitution occurrences.
gql: MATCH (m1:Material)-[sf:SubstitutesFor]-(m2:Material) RETURN m1, m2, sf.substitution_reason AS Reason, COUNT(sf) AS SubstitutionCount NEXT RETURN m1.name AS OriginalMaterial, m2.name AS SubstituteMaterial, Reason, SubstitutionCount ORDER BY SubstitutionCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find all products that have at least one engineering change modification with an impact level of 'High', and list their names along with the count of such high-impact changes.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[mb:ModifiedBy]->(ec:EngineeringChange) WHERE mb.change_impact_level = 'High' RETURN p.name AS ProductName, COUNT(ec) AS HighImpactChangesCount

question: Identify the engineering changes that affected products or assemblies which are associated with work centers located in 'Factory A'. Include the engineering change ID, description, and approval status.
gql: MATCH (ec:EngineeringChange)<-[mb:ModifiedBy]-(n)-[ma:ManufacturedAt]->(wc:WorkCenter) WHERE wc.location = 'Factory A' RETURN DISTINCT ec.EngineeringChange_id AS EngineeringChangeID, ec.description AS Description, ec.approval_status AS ApprovalStatus

question: Retrieve the names of suppliers who supply materials used in products with a status of 'Active', along with the count of distinct materials supplied by each supplier.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[co:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, COUNT(m) AS DistinctMaterialsCount

question: Find the top 5 suppliers based on the total quantity of materials they have supplied, considering only those materials used in products with a status of 'Active'.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN s.name AS SupplierName, SUM(m.unit_cost) AS TotalSuppliedValue ORDER BY TotalSuppliedValue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all work centers that are involved in manufacturing products which have undergone engineering changes, including the total cycle time spent at each work center for such products.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`)-[:ModifiedBy]->(ec:EngineeringChange) RETURN wc.name AS WorkCenterName, SUM(ma.cycle_time) AS TotalCycleTime

question: Determine the total setup time required for all manufacturing processes involving assemblies that are part of products with a BomVersion status of 'Approved'.
gql: MATCH (bv:BomVersion{status:'Approved'})<-[:HasBomVersion]-(p:`Product`)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(a:Assembly)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(wc:WorkCenter) RETURN SUM(ma.setup_time) AS TotalSetupTime

question: Retrieve the top 5 products with the highest total material cost, calculated based on the unit cost of materials and their required quantities in the BOM, and display the product name and total cost.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN p.name AS ProductName, SUM(m.unit_cost) AS TotalMaterialCost ORDER BY TotalMaterialCost DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find suppliers related to material 'M000001' with contract terms of 'Long Term' in a two-hop path, and limit the return to 1 path.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Material)-[e1:SourcedFrom]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:Material) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" AND n2.Material_id <> "M000001" RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Find results from material 'M000001' connected through 1 to 3 hops of any type of edges to nodes with 'Supplier' label, and limit the return to 5 records.
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:Supplier) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Find nodes with specific material ID and further obtain downstream nodes directly connected to it and related edge information.
gql: MATCH (nodes_1:Material) WHERE nodes_1.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN nodes_1 NEXT MATCH (nodes_1)-[edges_1:SourcedFrom]->(nodes_2:Supplier) RETURN nodes_2, nodes_1, edges_1 LIMIT 10

question: Calculate the number of distinct target nodes associated with Material nodes having specific attribute values (name = 'Employee wait').
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[]->(n2) WHERE n1.name = "Employee wait" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Find all paths from Material nodes to Supplier nodes connected through SourcedFrom edges, return these edges and target Supplier nodes, limited to 10 records.
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n2) RETURN e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Precisely find material node information with material ID 'M000001'.
gql: MATCH (n:Material) WHERE n.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN n LIMIT 10

question: Calculate the number of distinct suppliers connected to material 'M000001'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[]->(n2) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Find all paths from material 'M000001' reaching other materials through one or two hops (up to three hops), and the target material cannot be 'M000001' itself. Union all qualifying one-hop and two-hop paths, each taking top 5.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Material)-[]-(x)-[]-(n2:Material) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" AND n2.Material_id <> "M000001" RETURN p LIMIT 5 UNION ALL MATCH p = (n1:Material)-[]-(x)-[]-(y)-[]-(n2:Material) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" AND n2.Material_id <> "M000001" RETURN p LIMIT 5

question: Find all supplier nodes connected from material 'M000001' through 1 to 3 hops, return the starting material and final supplier information, limit to 5 pairs.
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[]-{1,3}(n2) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Get target nodes pointed to by sourcing relationships with contract terms of 'Long Term' and minimum order quantity greater than 800, return the node and delivery_schedule attribute in the sourcing relationship, show at most 10 results.
gql: MATCH (a:Material {Material_id: "M000001"})-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n) WHERE e.contract_terms = "Long Term" AND e.minimum_order_quantity > 800 RETURN n, e.delivery_schedule LIMIT 10

question: Retrieve two-hop paths from material 'M000001' through intermediate nodes to another material (not 'M000001'), where the destination material must be different from the starting material, return only the first 1 such path.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Material)-[]-(x)-[]-(n2:Material) WHERE n1.Material_id = "M000001" AND n2.Material_id <> "M000001" RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Find all downstream nodes and their relationships connected to material with Material_id 'M000001', and limit the return to 10 records.
gql: MATCH (nodes_1:Material) WHERE nodes_1.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN nodes_1 NEXT MATCH (nodes_1)-[edges_1:SourcedFrom]->(nodes_2) RETURN nodes_2, nodes_1, edges_1 LIMIT 10

question: Find all materials belonging to category 'Hardware' and their associated sourcing information, and limit the return to top 10 records.
gql: MATCH (m:Material)-[s:SourcedFrom]->(sup) WHERE m.category = "Hardware" RETURN s, sup LIMIT 10

question: Find supplier information of materials with category 'Hardware' connected through 'SourcedFrom' edges, where contract terms are 'Long Term'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n2) WHERE n1.category = "Hardware" AND e.contract_terms = "Long Term" RETURN n1, e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Find suppliers connected to material 'M000001' through 'SourcedFrom' edges, and filter records where minimum order quantity is greater than 800.
gql: MATCH (a:Material {Material_id: "M000001"})-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n) WHERE e.minimum_order_quantity > 800 RETURN n, e.supplier_part_number LIMIT 10

question: Count the number of distinct suppliers associated with materials in category 'Hardware'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Material)-[]->(n2) WHERE n1.category = "Hardware" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as supplier_count

question: Find supplier nodes related to material 'M000001' and the sourcing relationship edges between them, and limit the return to top 10 results.
gql: MATCH (n:Material)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(s) WHERE n.Material_id = "M000001" RETURN e, s LIMIT 10

question: Find all materials with category 'Hardware' and return their information, return at most 10 records.
gql: MATCH (n:Material) WHERE n.category = "Hardware" RETURN n LIMIT 10

question: Find materials with name 'Employee wait' but specification not equal to 'Talk including pressure conference analysis.', connected through SourcedFrom relationship to supplier nodes forming a two-hop path, return the path and take only one.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Material)-[e1:SourcedFrom]->(x)<-[e2]-(n2:Material) WHERE n1.name = "Employee wait" AND n2.specification <> "Talk including pressure conference analysis." RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Find the total quantity required for each material used in products that are currently in 'Active' status, grouped by material name.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE p.status = 'Active' RETURN m.name, SUM(c.quantity_required) AS total_quantity

question: Calculate the average cycle time for manufacturing products at each work center, considering only those products that have been modified by at least one engineering change, and order the results by average cycle time ascending.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ManufacturedAt]->(w:WorkCenter), (p)-[:ModifiedBy]->(:EngineeringChange) RETURN w.name, AVG(w.cycle_time) AS avg_cycle_time ORDER BY avg_cycle_time ASC

question: List all suppliers who provide materials that are substitutes for other materials, including the original and substitute material names and substitution reason.
gql: MATCH (m1:Material)<-[:SubstitutesFor]-(m2:Material)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Supplier) RETURN s.name AS supplier_name, m1.name AS original_material, m2.name AS substitute_material, m2.substitution_reason

question: Retrieve the average setup time and cycle time for products assembled at work centers with operating hours '24/7', grouped by product name.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[ma:ManufacturedAt]->(wc:WorkCenter) WHERE wc.operating_hours = '24/7' RETURN p.name, avg(ma.setup_time) AS avg_setup_time, avg(ma.cycle_time) AS avg_cycle_time

question: Identify the top 5 work centers with the highest total capacity that have been used to manufacture products with a 'Revision' status of 'D' and sort them by their operating hours.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[:ManufacturedAt]-(p:`Product`) WHERE p.revision_level = 'D' RETURN wc.WorkCenter_id, wc.name, wc.capacity, wc.operating_hours ORDER BY wc.capacity DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total quantity required of each material across all products and assemblies?
gql: MATCH (v)-[c:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN m.Material_id, m.name, SUM(c.quantity_required) AS total_quantity_required

question: Find the total quantity required for all materials used in products that are currently in 'Development' status, grouped by material category.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`{status:'Development'})-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN m.category AS MaterialCategory, SUM(m.quantity_required) AS TotalQuantityRequired

question: Calculate the average cycle time for manufacturing orders grouped by the product's unit of measure, excluding orders with a status of 'Cancelled'.
gql: MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[:OrderedFor]->(p:`Product`) WHERE mo.status <> 'Cancelled' RETURN p.unit_of_measure AS UnitOfMeasure, AVG(mo.cycle_time) AS AverageCycleTime

question: For each manufacturing order with a status of 'Completed', find the total quantity required of each material used in the ordered products or assemblies, grouped by material name.
gql: MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[r:OrderedFor]->(n)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE mo.status = 'Completed' RETURN m.name, SUM(r.required_quantity) AS total_quantity_required

question: Retrieve the names of materials and their total required quantities across all products and assemblies, excluding those with an alternative flag set to true in their relationships.
gql: MATCH (n)-[co:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE co.alternative_flag <> true RETURN m.name, SUM(co.quantity_required) AS total_quantity_required

question: Identify the total quantity required for each material used in products that are currently in 'Active' status, grouped by material name and ordered by the total quantity in descending order.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`{status:'Active'})-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) RETURN m.name, SUM(m.quantity_required) AS total_quantity ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

question: Which products have at least one substitute material with a priority ranking below 5? Return the product ID and the count of such substitute materials.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material)-[:SubstitutesFor]->(sm:Material) WHERE sm.priority_ranking < 5 RETURN p.Product_id, COUNT(sm) AS substitute_count

question: Identify the latest effective BomVersion for each product and assembly, including the version number and effective date.
gql: MATCH (bv:BomVersion)<-[:HasBomVersion]-(p_or_a) RETURN p_or_a, bv ORDER BY bv.effective_date DESC NEXT RETURN p_or_a.name, bv.version_number, bv.effective_date

question: Calculate the average setup time for manufacturing operations at work centers that have a capacity greater than 100 units.
gql: MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[:ManufacturedAt]-(entity) WHERE wc.capacity > 100 RETURN avg(entity.setup_time) AS average_setup_time

question: Identify the top 5 most substituted materials along with their substitution reason and approval level, ordered by priority ranking?
gql: MATCH (m1:Material)-[s:SubstitutesFor]->(m2:Material) RETURN m1.name, s.substitution_reason, s.approval_level ORDER BY s.priority_ranking LIMIT 5

question: Which products have at least one substitute material with a higher unit cost? Provide the product ID, name, and the count of such substitute materials.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m1:Material) RETURN p, m1 NEXT MATCH (m2:Material)-[:SubstitutesFor]->(m1) WHERE m2.unit_cost > m1 RETURN p.Product_id, p.name, COUNT(m2) AS substitute_count

question: Find all products that have at least one material with a unit cost higher than 100, and list their names along with the total number of such expensive materials they contain.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material) WHERE m.unit_cost > 100 RETURN p.name, COUNT(m) AS expensive_material_count

question: List all engineering changes that affect products currently in 'Development' status, including the change description and the product name.
gql: MATCH (p:`Product`)-[:ModifiedBy]->(ec:EngineeringChange) WHERE p.status = 'Development' RETURN ec.description, p.name

question: Identify suppliers who provide materials used in products that are ordered in manufacturing orders with quantities greater than 50. Return distinct supplier names and the count of such products.
gql: MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(p:`Product`)<-[:OrderedFor]-(mo:ManufacturingOrder) WHERE mo.quantity > 50 RETURN DISTINCT s.name, COUNT(p) AS product_count

question: Identify all suppliers who provide materials that are used in products with a revision level of 'C'. Include supplier names and contact info in the results.
